scope: Offline monthly exit-profit concentration accounting for existing fixed-hold-one daily-momentum rolling-window reports only.

reproduction.method: For each market, slice the final windowDays cached bars exactly as dailyMomentumRollingWindowStudy does, then call maintained simulateDailyMomentumPortfolio with the source report config.

monthBasis.includedMonths: Only exit-trading months containing at least one closed trade; edge months may be partial relative to the trailing window.
monthBasis.monthlyProfitFields: profitAmount already includes the source config costPercent; grossGainsKrw sums positive closed-trade profitAmount and grossLossesKrw sums the absolute value of negative closed-trade profitAmount.

concentrationRules.bestMonthSelection: Rank positive-net exit months only; best two uses up to two positive-net months.
concentrationRules.bestMonthShare: Share of total closed-trade net is null when total net is nonpositive. For positive total net it may exceed 100% when negative months offset top positive months.
concentrationRules.maximumPositiveMonthShareDenominator: Sum of positive monthly net profitAmount; included explicitly per run.
concentrationRules.residualAccounting: Subtract the selected positive-net month(s) from the recorded closed-trade accounting net; this is not a simulator rerun.

interpretationLimits: The trailing windows overlap and this configuration was selected after prior research; they are not independent holdouts and do not establish statistical significance.
Positive/negative residual net after omitting months is fixed-recorded-trade arithmetic only; it does not describe changed trade paths, return, or drawdown.
Cached historical simulator output is not actual fill evidence, forward validation, or profitability promotion.
No optimizer, parameter tuning, candidate discovery, market discovery, or market-set change was performed.
